main.description: A single Slay the Spire 2 run.

maxHp.description: Local player's maximum HP at the time of emission (reflects run-long HP gains/losses).

currentHp.description: Local player's current HP at the time of emission (0 if dead).

steamID64.description: SteamID64 of the run's owner, when playing on Steam.

killedBy.description: Enemy / event that ended the run, if applicable.

deck.description: Card ids in the final deck.

relics.description: Relic ids held at run end.

allies.description: Other players in a multiplayer run.

stats.description: Aggregated combat stats across the run. All fields optional; counters reflect the local player's own activity.

game.description: Optional at-uri of the canonical games.gamesgamesgamesgames.actor.game record for StS2.

statsRef.description: at-uri of the user's games.gamesgamesgamesgames.actor.stats record for StS2, updated alongside this run.

turns.description: Total player turns taken across all combats.

longestCombat.description: Most player turns in a single combat.

damageDealt.description: Total HP damage dealt by the player to enemies (after block).

damageTaken.description: Total HP damage taken by the player (after block).

biggestDamageDealt.description: Largest HP damage dealt by the player in one attack (after block).

biggestDamageTaken.description: Largest HP damage taken by the player in one attack (after block).

biggestTurnDamageDealt.description: Most HP damage the player dealt in one player turn (after block).

biggestTurnDamageTaken.description: Most HP damage the player took in one enemy turn (after block).

noDamageTurns.description: Enemy turns during which the player took zero unblocked damage.

highestBlockInTurn.description: Most block gained by the player in a single player turn.

healingReceived.description: Total HP healed by the player across the run (sum of positive HP changes).

lowestHp.description: Lowest HP the player reached at any tracked moment in the run.

deaths.description: Number of times the player went to 0 HP. 0 in solo victory; can exceed 1 in multiplayer where allies revive.

killCount.description: Number of monsters this player dealt the killing blow to.

goldEarned.description: Total gold gained over the run.

goldSpent.description: Total gold spent over the run.

goldCurrent.description: Gold the player is currently holding at the time of emission.

hitsDealtDistribution.description: Hits dealt by the player grouped by the attack's full value (before block). Example: { "1": 23, "2": 8, "10": 1 }.

hitsTakenDistribution.description: Hits the player received grouped by the attack's full value (before block). Example: { "1": 23, "2": 8, "10": 1 }.

cardUseDistribution.description: Cards played, keyed by card name (id) mapped to the number of times that card was played. Example: { "strike": 42, "bash": 6 }.

distribution.description: Generic histogram keyed by arbitrary string values mapped to their integer counts. Keys are intentionally undeclared because the set of values is open-ended.

cid.description: CIDv1 (DAG-CBOR + SHA-256) of the record body that was signed.

signature.description: P-256 ECDSA signature (low-S, IEEE P1363 r‖s) over the content CID bytes.

attestation.description: Inline ECDSA signature appended to the record's `signatures` array after the content CID is computed (per badge.blue). The `signatures` array is stripped before re-validation; entries identify the signing key so verifiers can look it up against a trusted-keys list to confirm a genuine mod build. The canonical list lives at https://sts2.byjp.me/.well-known/sts2-mod-keys/keys.json — other verifiers may publish their own at the same well-known path on a different host.
